newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York cites Montgomery Ward loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York cites Montgomery Ward loan.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc said in its second-quarter earnings release that subsequent to the end of the quarter a "substantial loan" to a retailer became nonperforming.
A Bank of New York spokesman declined to specify the amount of the loan. He said the retailer is Montgomery Ward Holding Corp, which filed for bankruptcy on July 7.

Bank of New York said nonperforming assets at the end of the second quarer totaled $243 million, compared to $248 million at the end of the first quarter of 1997. A $37 million increase in non-performing commercial real estate loans to $57 million was attributable to the addition of a loan on an office building in Pennsylvania, Bank of New York said.
